Game Overview

In Skibidi Hop, the core idea is straightforward: dodge the relentless Red triangle in Skibidi Hop, an endless adventure filled with dynamic challenges and intuitive controls. Perfect your timing to jump, survive, and achieve record-breaking scores on an alien planet. With each leap, delight in the thrill of outpacing your last performance in this captivating infinite runner.
